summary: The BC Cancer Agency's logo and emblem as vector paths from its 2015 Research Report (page 32), supplied with sources: also seen, as vector artwork, in the 2010 Radiation Therapy booklet (page 28; Pantone 273 U and Warm Gray 11 U; Illustrator template dated 21 June 2007) and, as a 162 × 162 monochrome image, on the September 2000 Fraser Valley Health Centre / Eastern Fraser Valley Cancer Centre project report. Replaced by the BC Cancer identity announced 15 November 2017. A 2014 photograph of the signage (Canuckle, CC BY-SA 3.0) is at https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:BC_Cancer_Agency_logo.jpg. See package-README.md and source-manifest.json.

assets.label: BC Cancer Agency — Emblem and name
assets.dateNote: The report’s year, not an adoption date; the designer and introduction date are not established.
assets.notes: The circular emblem beside “BC Cancer Agency”, with “CARE + RESEARCH” and the Provincial Health Services Authority line beneath, in blue and warm grey: the agency’s logo until its identity as BC Cancer in November 2017.
assets.fidelityNote: The report’s own vector paths, exported from PDF page 32 with the lettering already outlined; not traced or redrawn. Colours are the publication’s RGB rendering; the 2010 Radiation Therapy booklet names them as PANTONE 273 U (blue) and PANTONE Warm Gray 11 U, in artwork from an Illustrator file “BCCA_Template_Horz” dated 21 June 2007.
